target.title: Apply consented grouped Claw updates
target.body: ## Summary  - Extends experimental `claws update` from the read-only plan in #102959 to consented mutation across agent config, managed workspace files, packages, MCP declarations, cron jobs, and root provenance. - Requires both `--yes` and the exact `--plan-integrity` printed by the latest dry run. Immediately before mutation, it rebuilds the plan and rejects changed targets, live state, or ownership boundaries. - Applies each owner through compare-and-swap checks and compensates completed reversible owners in reverse order if a later owner fails. - Advances root package/version/integrity provenance only after every owner succeeds. - Reports `update_partial` when a package installer, source-config writer, or Gateway scheduler mutation cannot be proven fully compensated.  This remains behind `OPENCLAW_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS=1` and is the mutation stage for the preceding read-only update plan.  Stack references: - RFC: openclaw/rfcs#27 - Base/read-only planner: #102959 - Control UI plugin lifecycle alignment: #103176  ## Lifecycle contract  ```bash openclaw claws update <claw-or-agent> --from <source> --dry-run --json openclaw claws update <claw-or-agent> --from <source> \   --yes --plan-integrity <sha256-from-dry-run> --json ```  The executor binds consent to the full plan and fails closed if the target or current ownership changes before an individual mutation.  - **Workspace:** rooted filesystem operations verify expected source digest, destination presence/content, and provenance before each write. - **Packages:** exact ClawHub versions use shared installers and lifecycle leases. Referenced removals release only this Claw's row; managed removals use the existing package-removal planner and uninstall path before releasing provenance. Package installer outcomes without a mutation receipt remain explicitly uncertain. - **MCP:** validated config writes use compare-and-swap expectations. Removal distinguishes deleting an exact managed declaration from releasing referenced ownership. - **Cron:** Gateway-owned operations converge on stable Claw declaration keys and preserve explicit partial-state semantics for non-transactional scheduler writes. - **Provenance:** package, MCP, workspace, cron, and root writes preserve the final managed/referenced, origin, and independent-owner model from the preceding lifecycle PRs.  ## Real behavior proof  An earlier isolated WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 stack head exercised grouped preview, consented apply, and status for agent config, managed workspace files, and a remote OAuth MCP declaration. That transcript is prior-head evidence, not exact-head proof for this restack.  Live exact package replacement, Gateway-backed cron convergence, and retained-artifact diagnosis/recovery remain explicit maintainer proof requests before merge. The current head has focused injected and SQLite coverage for those mutation, race, rollback, and partial-state contracts. The initial experimental recovery contract is fail closed, report `update_partial`, preserve uncertain state, and require operator inspection/replanning; a richer doctor/reconcile operation identity remains a maintainer follow-up choice.  ## Validation  Current head: `3667eb6d4e07d922742aca9d4a601d6c62c52e0f`.  - 82 focused unit and CLI tests pass across update execution, package lifecycle/provenance, workspace, MCP, cron, root provenance, and CLI consent. - Real SQLite regressions cover package reference CAS, managed uninstall/release distinctions, MCP release rollback, and complete ownership timestamps. - Race regressions cover disappearing agents/workspace targets, source MCP changes, concurrent package ownership, stale release provenance, and plugin preflight rejection. - Changed-file `oxfmt`, `oxlint --deny-warnings`, and `git diff --check` pass. - Exact branch review against `82bcde001d69249e9b880301ae6974d6e5296196`: `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported` after fixing consent, package digest/release/remove, and stale-agent races. - Full local production typecheck is not claimed: the reused WSL dependency tree has unrelated `semver`, `p-limit`, and `execa` skew. GitHub CI is the authoritative full type/dependency proof for this head.  ## Stack note  This is a ready stacked PR. Do not merge it before #102959 and the earlier Claws ownership/lifecycle slices settle.
